dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Good night! Ahh... At this hour, I'd usually be proofreading a manuscript or drafting my next one...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: I'm not used to having so much free time. Hahaha...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: *gasp* Wait... Did I submit my latest article? I think I did...? Yeah, pretty sure I did...
